_comment: Persistent Exploration lane for The Docket. Whenever Ari logs a NEW interest, append a small, inviting item here (a first step, never a project) plus its Command Center task, and store that task's page id as notionId so the row is checkable. The renderer rotates 3 items per day, so this list can grow past three without burying anything. When an item's Notion task goes Done, add "retired": "<date>" instead of deleting it — retired items drop out of the lane and the rotation but keep their history and their notionId.
